youtube.baslik: In implant auditory training, do you work on sounds or sentences? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Auditory training approaches fall into two basic orientations. Analytic training focuses on small units of speech, meaning sounds, syllables and the differences between them; for example, the person practices telling bat and pat apart, words that differ only in voicing. Synthetic training aims to grasp the whole meaning at the sentence and conversation level, using context; analytic training strengthens bottom-up processing, and synthetic training top-down processing. Most programs combine the two; the balance is set by the person's level and goal.
